implementation_scope: mechanism-faithful reduced-scale DMC demonstration; not an exact large-scale reproduction of the original benchmarks

architecture_contract.simsiam: 3-layer BatchNorm projector with affine-free output BatchNorm; 2-layer BatchNorm predictor; stop-gradient cosine loss
architecture_contract.byol: online and EMA target networks with BatchNorm MLP heads and cosine loss
architecture_contract.barlow_twins: 3-layer BatchNorm projector and cross-correlation redundancy-reduction loss
architecture_contract.backbone: shared lightweight convolutional encoder rather than the original large-scale benchmark backbone
